item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. You've built real structure into today — meditation, wind-down time, check-in points. Use them. The harder skill is catching yourself mid-assumption, when you're sure you know what someone else is thinking or feeling without asking. That certainty is usually a story, not a fact. Same with old patterns — noticing them is the first way to break them. Action: once today, when you catch yourself assuming, stop and ask instead.
